verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical and share the same flaws. The original's full-bleed stripes behind a white card have become three small separate bars stuck on the left, so the brand composition is lost. The copy is broken into scattered pieces with no grid: the 'for all drinkware on' fragment is tiny, wraps awkwardly and floats at the bottom left, and the vertical URL is too small to read and stranded in the middle. The product list sits off on its own at the right, leaving dead white space throughout.
